scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Monday’s Maple Towers lobby food-scrap Q&A able to show the countertop caddy-and-liner demo kit rather than only photo cards.
Emerging Need: Resident interest and event confirmation make the physical kit relevant, but the kit still lacks the named locked host storage required before the outreach tote manifest closes.
Decision Context: Early planning and generic kit availability do not justify a hold; stored material rules identify the storage prerequisite, substitute, staging route, and cutoff while the contact card supplies a feasible host liaison.
Consequence: Timely low-commitment coordination preserves the demo without spending or promising service changes; after manifest sealing, the Q&A can proceed only with flat reference materials.

parameter.title: Maple Towers food-scrap lobby Q&A
parameter.description: Tentative apartment-lobby question table on food-scrap collection basics; materials list not set.

parameter.subject: Weekend routing for apartment food-scrap demo kits
parameter.body: The countertop pail demo kits are being routed through Reuse Center staging this weekend for apartment pop-ups that fit the staging rules. Kit supply is tight, so the apartment tote manifest will decide which sites get a physical kit versus flat photo cards.

parameter.content: Maple Towers residents left 16 interest slips this morning, and several specifically asked to see the countertop pail and liner setup in person if Monday's lobby table is confirmed.

parameter.title: Maple Towers food-scrap lobby Q&A
parameter.description: Confirmed apartment-lobby question table on food-scrap collection basics. Oona and Nia have selected a live countertop caddy-and-liner demonstration; the physical kit is not yet staged, and its host-storage line is still blank.

parameter.name: Tessa Monroe
parameter.notes: Weekend contact card from the apartment network: can approve use of the locked community-room closet for Monday lobby materials; front desk cannot accept loose tote drop-offs.

parameter.subject: Apartment tote manifest sealed for Monday runs
parameter.body: The apartment-outreach tote manifest sealed at 13:00. Maple Towers is listed for photo cards only unless a host storage name was already on the manifest before sealing.
